def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    div_cols=[c for c in range(w) if len(set(g[r][c] for r in range(h)))==1 and g[0][c]!=0]
    div_rows=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=0]
    if not div_cols: return g
    c0=div_cols[0]
    # pattern block: columns right of first divider (between c0 and next divider or edge)
    c1=next((c for c in div_cols if c>c0), w)
    block=[g[r][c0+1:c1] for r in range(h)]
    i=0
    for c in range(w):
        if c in div_cols: i=0; continue
        for r in range(h): g[r][c]=block[r][i]
        i+=1
    return g
